chunk_reconstruction_proof: Source is a sum of signed monomials with nonnegative integer exponents. Splitting before the final plus/minus preserves its sign in the carry buffer. Each earlier chunk consists of complete monomials. Retained chunks append a plus exactly when a prior chunk was written and the next chunk starts without a minus. Original source_index/h/x/y prefixes are preserved; all-zero rows are omitted only after each monomial has an explicit UX factor. Thus chunking changes neither the exact coordinate image nor its cofactor decomposition.
scope: No new large cache hashing or CAS performed here; runtime runner checks full cache SHA while streaming. Independent metadata checks and audited identical filter functions supply I_original+UX=I_cache+UX. Cache alone is not asserted equivalent to original I.
